notes.title: 🔥 🎉 The Dough Has Risen! FuryDough is Here! 🎉 🔥🤪
notes.content:
Two long years, countless hours... and way too many donuts. 🍩 Fueled by sugar and a dream, I devoured them all while crafting this game.

But don’t worry—I saved a few for you! 
Actually, hordes of crazy donuts. 🕹️ Grab FuryDough now, almost for free (cheaper than your morning coffee), and dive into a roguelite adventure baked with love, chaos, and just the right amount of glaze.

Don’t let this one get stale—your next adventure is fresh out of the oven! 🍞

[h1]Buy and play FuryDough Now![/h1]

notes.title: 🎉 Exciting News: New Demo of FuryDough Now Available! 🎮
notes.content:
[h3]What’s in the Demo?[/h3]

[list]
[*] Explore Randomly Generated Mazes: Each level features unique, randomly generated mazes, providing a fresh experience every time you play.
[*] Unlock New Abilities: In this demo, you can experiment with two abilities that will help you tackle the challenges ahead. Use them strategically to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, and I hope you enjoy the demo!

Happy gaming!
